# Amplitude

> Connect Zenflow Work to Amplitude to access product analytics, usage data, and user behavior insights.

<span className="set-page-badge-native" />

<Note>
  This native integration requires a Zencoder account.
</Note>

## Overview

The Amplitude integration gives the AI agent access to your product analytics. Query usage data, track user behavior, analyze funnels, and surface insights — all from within a Zenflow task.

<Note>
  Amplitude integration is based on [Amplitude MCP](https://amplitude.com/docs/amplitude-ai/amplitude-mcp)
</Note>

## Connecting Amplitude

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Settings & Integrations">
    Navigate to **Settings → Integrations** in the Zenflow sidebar.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Find Amplitude">
    Locate **Amplitude** in the Integrations Catalog.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Click Connect">
    Click the **Connect** or **\[+]** button on the Amplitude card.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Select Region">
    In the connection popup, select the region in which your Amplitude is located:

    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4/images/integrations/amplitude/region-selection.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4&q=85&s=0ce4ecb194139c385f811bb892336b32" alt="amplitude scope screen" width="1697" height="372" data-path="images/integrations/amplitude/region-selection.png" />
  </Step>

  <Step title="Authorize Connection">
    Authenticate and authorize Zenflow to access your Amplitude workspace via the secure OAuth popup window:
    Click **Authorize**

    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4/images/integrations/amplitude/authorization-screen.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4&q=85&s=b57e6da3ed105b103b3a57623371ea43" alt="amplitude scope screen" width="1043" height="563" data-path="images/integrations/amplitude/authorization-screen.png" />

    You should get a modal asking if you want to open Zenflow, click **Open Zenflow**

    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4/images/integrations/amplitude/open-zenflow-screen.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4&q=85&s=6835447644413a0ca1a4f24274dd9678" alt="open zenflow modal" width="1202" height="1078" data-path="images/integrations/amplitude/open-zenflow-screen.png" />
  </Step>

  <Step title="Integration enabled">
    <img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4/images/integrations/amplitude/connected-integration-zenflow.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=WZGWyEgQ7UortYL4&q=85&s=3f9ec43fd7dd6c2b22a95938d92ce36a" alt="amplitude integration connected" width="1710" height="184" data-path="images/integrations/amplitude/connected-integration-zenflow.png" />
  </Step>
</Steps>

## What the Agent Can Do

* **Query analytics** — Pull usage metrics, DAU/MAU, retention, and engagement data
* **Analyze funnels** — Review conversion funnels and identify drop-off points
* **Track user behavior** — Access event data and user journey insights
* **Surface trends** — Identify usage patterns and feature adoption rates

## Example Use Cases

* Generate weekly product usage reports for stakeholders
* Identify features with declining engagement for prioritization
* Pull retention data for QBR prep documents
* Monitor adoption metrics after a new feature launch

Browse ready-to-use templates in the **[Zencoder Marketplace](https://zencoder.ai/marketplace)**.
